requirement.original: Create an independent Cafe POI type in the travel planner system. This is NOT about making meals flexible -- it is about creating a brand new domain alongside meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping, accommodation, and transportation.
requirement.clarified: Create a complete cafe domain: schema (cafe.schema.json), agent (cafe.md), data file (cafe.json), and integrate with HTML generator, validation, image fetching, save/load, sync, and budget systems. Cafe uses array-based day structure (like entertainment) rather than named-slot structure (like meals). Migrate ALL existing cafe entries from meals.json across ALL days.
requirement.what: New cafe POI type with full system integration
requirement.why: Cafe entries (coffee shops, teahouses, rest spots) do not fit the breakfast/lunch/dinner structure of meals. They can happen at any time and deserve their own independent domain.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Cafe-type POIs (coffee shops, teahouses) forced into meals.json as breakfast alternatives AND primaries with artificial time constraints
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: System has no independent cafe domain -- only breakfast/lunch/dinner meal slots exist
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural gap, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original design assumed all food/drink activities fit into 3 daily meal slots
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Cafes are not meals -- they can happen at any time and do not map to breakfast/lunch/dinner. Forcing them into meal slots creates scheduling conflicts and semantic confusion. Day 15 has a coffee shop as breakfast PRIMARY, which is semantically wrong.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward architectural extension following established patterns in the codebase (entertainment.schema.json as template)

file_contents.schemas/meals.schema.json: Named-slot structure: day_entry has breakfast/lunch/dinner properties each referencing meal_slot (which contains primary + alternatives). meal_item has: name_base, name_local, location_base, location_local, coordinates, cost, currency_local, cuisine_base, cuisine_local, signature_dishes_base, signature_dishes_local, notes_base, notes_local, search_results, optional, image_url, is_home
file_contents.schemas/entertainment.schema.json: Array-based structure: day_entry has entertainment property (array of entertainment_item). entertainment_item has: name_base, name_local, location_base, location_local, coordinates, cost, currency_local, type_base, type_local, note_base, note_local, notes_base, notes_local, search_results, optional, image_url, is_home. Required: name_base, name_local, location_base, location_local, cost, currency_local, type_base, optional
file_contents.schemas/poi-common.schema.json: Shared definitions: coordinates ({lat, lng}), search_result, cost_field, currency_code, bilingual_name, bilingual_location, day_header, agent_envelope, image_url
file_contents.schemas/budget.schema.json: budget_categories $def (line 53-84): has properties meals, accommodation, activities, shopping, transportation, total. Required: all 6. CRITICAL: additionalProperties: true (line 83) -- unknown keys pass validation silently but won't be summed unless explicitly added to HTML generator totals.
file_contents.scripts/plan-validate.py: AGENT_CONFIGS auto-derived from schemas via _derive_agent_configs(). Auto-registers any agent with properly structured schema. HOWEVER: agent_item_mapping (line 228-234) is HARDCODED with 5 agents: meals->meal_item, attractions->attraction_item, entertainment->entertainment_item, accommodation->accommodation_item, shopping->shopping_item. This mapping drives AGENTS_WITH_LOCAL (line 75). Cafe must be added: 'cafe': 'cafe_item'.
file_contents.scripts/load.py: Auto-derives agent POI keys from schemas via _derive_agent_poi_keys(). Only timeline has manual overrides. No code change needed for adding cafe.
file_contents.scripts/save.py: POI_AGENTS = {meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping} (line 56). _collect_day_pois (line 75-84) has THREE explicit branches: (1) meals (line 77-78), (2) accommodation (line 79-81), (3) attractions/entertainment/shopping (line 82-83). Line 84 returns [] for ANY agent not in these branches. There is NO generic fallback. Cafe must be added to the list on line 82: change ['attractions', 'entertainment', 'shopping'] to ['attractions', 'entertainment', 'shopping', 'cafe'].
file_contents.scripts/fetch-images-batch.py: TWO agent_files lists: line 667-673 (collect_pois method) and line 1061-1067 (update_images method). BOTH must add ('cafe.json', 'cafe', 'cafe'). Processing uses per-field_name if/elif branches: attractions (line 698/854/1096), meals (line 717), accommodation (line 765), entertainment (line 794/941/1184), shopping (line 823/970/1216). Cafe needs elif branches after shopping in ALL three code paths.
